scope: research-only strict-prequential short MC1-equivalent atop MDA90 opportunity + T5 conversion + K0

contract.upstream: frozen MDA90 P(MFE_H12 > 200 bps) + frozen T5 low-regret conversion + frozen K0 analytic mixture
contract.mapper: HistGradientBoostingRegressor depth=2, iter=80, lr=0.04, L2=20, min_leaf=100, seed=1729
contract.mapper_target: exact policy net bps clipped only to [-500,+500] for fitting
contract.admission: MC variants: expected policy net >= +50 bps; K0 native retained at its existing outer-train inner-OOF p80 threshold
contract.dynamic_state: strictly prior-resolved, equal-day 21-day residual history with 10% tail trimming; invalid paths excluded

focused_tests: future outcome mutation cannot change earlier state
agreement inputs are independent of realised outcome

decision.reason: Agreement-only calibration provides only a marginal 2025 gain and worsens 2026 CVaR/worst-month behavior. The exact 21-day global-shift and band-correctness equivalents materially degrade performance.
